name: inkeedecoder-mcp
description: Search INKEEDecoder cosmetic product and ingredient data over MCP.

tools.name: inkeedecoder_search
tools.description: Search INKEEDecoder products and ingredients by name.

tools.name: inkeedecoder_search_products
tools.description: Advanced product search filtered by ingredients a product must or must not contain.

tools.name: inkeedecoder_get_product
tools.description: Read a product page: brand, description, and full ingredient list.

tools.name: inkeedecoder_get_ingredient
tools.description: Read an ingredient page: functions, rating, irritancy, and comedogenicity.

tools.name: inkeedecoder_get_ingredient_products
tools.description: List products that contain a given ingredient.

tools.name: inkeedecoder_get_brand
tools.description: Read a brand and its catalogue.

tools.name: inkeedecoder_get_ingredient_function
tools.description: Read an ingredient function (for example emollient) and the ingredients filed under it.

tools.name: inkeedecoder_ping
tools.description: Connectivity and configuration check; sends no request to the site.
